# FormLayout

`Flare.Components.FormLayout`

Controls the visual layout of form fields inside a FlareForm.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Vertical` | `0` | Fields stack vertically (default). |
| `Horizontal` | `1` | Label and input sit side by side in each row. |
| `Inline` | `2` | Fields flow inline, wrapping as needed. |

## Used by components

- `FlareForm`
